envelope.description: Key the persistent exploration cache on the area and raise its version

body.title: Key the persistent exploration cache on the area and raise its version
body.summary: Hash scopeAreaKey into the cache params of concept.resolve, the doc.* explorations and capability.reuse-check through one key function used by the executor and by the narrow phase's write; raise EXPLORATION_CACHE_VERSION to 3 so older rows (without an anchor) are not read.
acceptanceChecks: two consecutive same-question requests on different modules do not share an entry on either tool, including capability.reuse-check
a version-2 row is not read
the narrow write and the executor write use the same key function

tests.name: exploration-cache-scope.test.ts: the key differs per area and per version, a version-2 row is not read and the narrow write uses the executor's key

cache-area-isolation.test.ts: consecutive same-question requests on different modules, including capability.reuse-check, do not share an entry on the step and one-shot tools and a version-2 row is not read
